reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for National Accounts Statistics
reports.description: The May 2012 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering national accounts. One of the eight dataset-specific frameworks for which the generic DQAF serves as the umbrella; it states which international manual each dimension of quality is assessed against, and is the instrument IMF staff use when assessing a country's national accounts in a Report on the Observance of Standards and Codes.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for the Consumer Price Index
reports.description: The May 2012 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering the consumer price index. Assesses methodological soundness against the national accounts standard for coverage and valuation and against the Consumer Price Index Manual for compilation methods.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for the Producer Price Index
reports.description: The May 2012 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering the producer price index, built on the same structure as the CPI framework and assessed against the national accounts standard together with the Producer Price Index Manual.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for Government Finance Statistics and Public Sector Debt Statistics
reports.description: The May 2012 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering government finance statistics. Written against the 2001 edition of the Government Finance Statistics Manual, with institutional sectors taken from the national accounts standard. Superseded for the debt half by the August 2024 public sector debt framework, which is a separate document.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for Public Sector Debt Statistics
reports.description: The August 2024 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering public sector debt statistics — the newest of the eight and the only one revised since 2013. Assessed against the 2013 Public Sector Debt Statistics Guide and the 2014 Government Finance Statistics Manual.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for Monetary Statistics
reports.description: The May 2012 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering monetary statistics, assessed against the 2000 Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and its 2008 Compilation Guide, with concepts and definitions referred back to the 1993 national accounts standard.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Statistics
reports.description: The May 2012 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering balance of payments and international investment position statistics, assessed against the sixth edition of the balance of payments manual and citing the UN merchandise trade recommendations for the goods component.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

reports.title: Data Quality Assessment Framework (DQAF) for External Debt Statistics
reports.description: The September 2013 dataset-specific edition of the IMF's Data Quality Assessment Framework covering external debt statistics, assessed against the External Debt Statistics Guide together with the sixth edition of the balance of payments manual.
reports.cadence_note: Evergreen assessment framework, revised only when the underlying manual is; releases_per_year is a nominal 0.06 because the schema wants a number.

_dropped.why: NOT MINTED 2026-09-06 (round 4), on scope rather than evidence. The SDDS methodology table's socio-demographic block lists Education, Health and Poverty methodologies (ICD-10 among them, which IS a corpus node and IS named by full title). Those are General Data Dissemination System categories, not SDDS data categories — SDDS is macroeconomic — and the page carries them because it doubles as the reference table for the whole Data Standards Initiatives family. Minting them onto imf-sdds would assert a requirement the SDDS does not impose. Population is the exception and IS minted: it is a genuine SDDS socio-demographic category. If the GDDS categories are ever wanted, they belong on imf-e-gdds and want e-GDDS-side evidence.
